sources.title: GCU Fall 2026 Academic Catalog — BS Business Administration
sources.scope: Printed pages 61–62: all sixteen required four-credit major courses, 64 major credits, 34–40 general education, 16–22 electives and 120 total. BUS-340 and BUS-485 carry the writing-intensive designation.

sources.title: GCU Bachelor of Science in Business Administration — current official program curriculum and course prerequisites
sources.scope: Program states campus and online availability, 120 semester credits, 64-credit major and 34–40 general education / 16–22 elective ranges. The sixteen named major courses each carry four credits. Program page academic approval date: September 15, 2026.

sources.title: GCU Fall 2026 Academic Catalog — Bachelor of Science general education
sources.scope: Printed pages 54–56 list the five general education competencies and named GCU course choices. BS ranges: foundations 4, communication 9–12, worldview 4, critical thinking 11–12, global awareness 6–8. UNV-103/303 and CWV-101/301 are marked non-transferable in the published sequence; campus students can have additional approved choices.

sources.title: GCU Fall 2026 University Policy Handbook — baccalaureate transfer policies
sources.scope: Printed pages 261–262: maximum 90 transfer credits, at most 84 lower-division; 30 combined alternative credits; another 30 maximum from military schools/training; all other transfer must be on an accredited GCU-approved originating college transcript. Lower-division substitutions do not become upper-division credit. Undergraduate transfer generally requires C or better; pass grades must equate to C. No duplicate/remedial credit.

sources.title: GCU Fall 2026 University Policy Handbook — degree credit minimum and transfer shortfalls
sources.scope: Printed page 262 quarter-conversion example preserves 2.67 earned credits toward 120 even when English content is fulfilled. Printed page 267 allows GCU Service Learning coursework to fill a transfer-related shortfall toward 120 in the major/elective categories; Service Learning cannot fulfill general education. Content substitution never establishes a larger credit award.

sources.title: GCU Fall 2026 Academic Catalog — named unrestricted elective selections
sources.scope: The BSBA has an open elective allowance. INT-244, COM-100, SOC-102 and SOC-220 are actual named four-credit university courses. They are selected examples, not additional required major courses or a promise of registration availability.
